name: – Željana Zovko – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Agreement between the European Union, Iceland, the Principality of Liechtenstein and the Kingdom of Norway on an EEA Financial Mechanism for the period May 2021 - April 2028, the Agreement between the Kingdom of Norway and the European Union on a Norwegian Financial Mechanism for the period May 2021 - April 2028, the Additional Protocol to the Agreement between the European Economic Community and the Kingdom of Norway and the Additional Protocol to the Agreement between the European Economic Community and Iceland
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway should keep paying into a shared fund that helps reduce economic and social gaps across the wider European market. Norway also pays separately. In return, Iceland and Norway get better terms for selling fish into the European Union, and Norway lets European Union boats land their catches there. The Parliament accepts the whole package but says the fish deal with Norway is unbalanced and asks the European Commission to fix this.

- Three countries pay 3.268 billion euro into the fund from May 2021 to April 2028.
- Iceland and Norway get new fish trade terms; Norway lets European Union boats land catches.
- The Parliament has approved the deal; it now takes effect.
